79518.subject: Сховище iCloud заповнено
79518.body:
Вітаємо, Oleh Novosadov!

Ваше сховище iCloud заповнено. Оскільки Ви використали передбачений тарифним планом обсяг сховища, документи, контакти та дані з пристроїв більше не архівуються в iCloud, а фото й відео не закачуються у Фото iCloud. iCloud Drive та програми з підтримкою iCloud не оновлюються на Ваших пристроях.

Щоб і надалі користуватися цими службами iCloud, потрібно оновити план до iCloud+: https://setup.icloud.com/email/prefs/storage?path=STORAGE_AND_BACKUP/CHANGE_STORAGE_PLAN або звільнити місце в сховищі.


Оновіть план до iCloud+ з 2 ТБ за 9,99 € на міс.: https://setup.icloud.com/email/prefs/storage?path=STORAGE_AND_BACKUP/CHANGE_STORAGE_PLAN

79512.subject: Bitcoin Hits Its Highest Since January as Crude Sinks 8%
79512.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[Bitcoin](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-highest-since-january-crude-sinks-sep-21-2026)**[ reached its highest level since January ](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-highest-since-january-crude-sinks-sep-21-2026)

* **[Kalshi's ether perp](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/one-size-dominates-kalshi-eth-perp-volume)**[ runs 63% of its notional through one repeating trade size](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/one-size-dominates-kalshi-eth-perp-volume)

* **[ZetaChain](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/zetachain-votes-to-wind-down-layer-1-and-move-zeta-to-solana)**[ voted to wind down its Layer 1](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/zetachain-votes-to-wind-down-layer-1-and-move-zeta-to-solana)

* **[Circle](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/circle-opens-bitcoin-backed-usdc-borrowing-to-mint-clients-on-morpho)**[ opened bitcoin-backed USDC borrowing to Mint clients on Morpho](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/circle-opens-bitcoin-backed-usdc-borrowing-to-mint-clients-on-morpho)

Bitcoin traded as high as $86,355 on Coinbase this morning, its best print since Jan. 29, in a leg that started in the 8 a.m. UTC hour and held through the New York open. Front-month WTI crude went the other way, settling Friday at $100.30 and changing hands at $92.17 on Monday, a decline of 8.1% and a fourth consecutive session lower. The Nasdaq Composite rose 1.6% and the 10-year Treasury yield eased to 4.96%.

Of the 125 largest non-stablecoin tokens, 106 rose. Solana added 9.9% to $119, XRP 8.6% to $1.50 and Dogecoin 14%, the biggest move among the 15 largest tokens. [DeFi total value locked reached $95.7 billion, up 9.6% on the week, while stablecoin supply added $70 million since Sept. 14](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-highest-since-january-crude-sinks-sep-21-2026). The TVL gain is collateral repricing.

Funding on the OKX and Deribit bitcoin swaps sits within a basis point of zero and both perpetuals trade below index, so holding a long costs almost nothing. Nansen's Nicolai Søndergaard reads the move as renewed ETF demand plus a short squeeze, with Hyperliquid's largest bitcoin traders still net short and more coin moving onto exchanges than off. Price has turned faster than positioning.

**Read more below!**

———————————————————————————

———————————————————————————

##### MARKETS

## Bitcoin Reaches Its Highest Level Since January as Crude Sinks 8%

Bitcoin opened the UTC day at $81,160 on Coinbase and traded as high as $86,355, a 6.4% gain and the highest print on that series since Jan. 29. It last changed hands at $86,194, up 6.8% over 24 hours and 9.8% over seven days. Ether was at $2,747, up 5.8% on the day. BNB rose 6.4% to $803, Zcash 5.9% to $1,520 and Cardano 10%.
